label: digit 3 fed back as input during copy phase
explanation: Fires almost only on copy-phase steps (t > L) where the input token is the digit 3, i.e. the model just re-emitted a 3 (99.8% of activation mass; ~0 activation on any other input, never in original or delimiter phases). Only about 28% of such steps are active, so firing is gated by position: rate and magnitude peak when the 3 is input around recall_idx 2-4 and near the end of the copy (to_go <= 3), and are much higher for short sequences (L 3-6); a 3 fed back at recall_idx 1 or early in long sequences (L 7-9) usually does not fire. Strongest activations are short sequences like 3 t 3 3 <DEL> 3 t [3] with the 3 input in the last couple of steps. Positional refinement (recall_idx 2-5 & to_go <= 3) raises dev F1 from 0.43 to 0.58 at mass recall 0.85; simple token predicate recorded.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: 3, p, k, t, -, r; least: 1, 0, e, m) and the token being output (most: 3, p, k, 2, r, o; least: w, -, n, 0); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, L=3 & t=4, recall_idx=4.
